triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Triage: lands in `area:build` · `domain:ui` · `priority:p2` · Bug · `pm:queue` (seat grade kept).
Rationale: creating a report from inside design mode shows two Save/Cancel sets, and the new report can silently detach from the menu slot it was created for. The maintainer ruled at 11:55Z 「照 Twenty 分开」: report editing becomes its own entry, mutually exclusive with design mode. This is a confusing Studio authoring flow with a silent-detach outcome but no lost data, so p2.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZeHNsF3RWcWpj7rGj

Measured evidence · 2026-11-23T13:52Z: the dashboard and existing-report halves of change item 3 (the two-way exclusion). Not new scope. Measured in the browser by the UI review thread, showcase app as admin, console built from main `9348f02b`; the dashboard and design-mode files are unchanged up to main `9e0c0c23`.

1. Design mode on, then the dashboard header's Edit on `showcase_ops_dashboard`: Edit is still offered. After the click the screen has two Save/Cancel sets, the design-mode bar (取消 / 保存) and the dashboard header (放弃 / 保存).
2. With both open, the top bar's 取消 ends design mode and the dashboard stays in edit mode.
3. Dashboard Edit first, then 编辑应用: 编辑应用 is still offered, and entering it gives the same two sets.
4. Design mode on, then Edit on an existing report page (`report/an_youxian_ji_tongji_renwu`): two sets again.

Screenshots (project files, `ui-review-2026-11-23/`): `07c-设计模式里再编辑仪表盘-两套保存.png`, `07d-顶栏取消后仪表盘仍在编辑.png`, `07e-设计模式里再编辑已有报表-两套保存.png`.

This answers the maintainer's question in the review thread 2026-11-23T13:49Z whether dashboard editing has the same problem: it does, and item 3 of this card covers it. No regrade and no dispatch change.
